policy.downstream_boundary: Framework V001 bundles and all frozen execution, integrity, classification, scoring, publication, and governance semantics remain unchanged.
policy.evidence_claim: Campaign evidence establishes routing, readiness, execution lineage, and reconciliation only; blocked status and synthetic evidence establish no trading edge.
policy.execution_authority: Only an executor contract frozen in this configuration and a byte-matching code registration may execute.
policy.failure_rule: Executor errors, identity drift, integrity failures, incomplete lifecycle evidence, or reconciliation defects abort publication.
policy.scope: Route every library entry to an exact authorized executor or publish a canonical blocked readiness result.
